dslRule:
<!id: eclipse.swt.composite.layout-all>
<!description: Update Composite.layout(true) to Composite.layout(true, true) to ensure all children are laid out, matching the intended behavior when relayouting a parent composite.>
<!severity: HINT>

((org.eclipse.swt.widgets.Composite) $parent).layout(true)
=>
((org.eclipse.swt.widgets.Composite) $parent).layout(true, true)
;;
